systems.system: Sistema de Informação para Gestão da Educação (SIGE)
systems.platform: SIGE platform, with structured Excel spreadsheets used at GEPE to finish checking the 2021/2022 data
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Gabinete de Estudos, Planeamento e Estatística (GEPE)
systems.tiers: GEPE sends the census questionnaires to the provincial education offices, which reproduce them and pass them through the municipal directorates to the schools to fill in and return; processing is at GEPE

systems.country_label: Censo Escolar Anual da Educação não superior
systems.tiers: all 18 provinces; every school in operation, in two collections a year (start and end of the school year)

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, GEPE, with the approval of the Instituto Nacional de Estatística

note: Passages file, read to its end (1,471 lines). No fact: SIGE as described is the circuit of the annual school census, a questionnaire per school returning counts at the start and the end of the year (field collection October 2021 to January 2022, coverage checks to December 2022), with no per-learner record and nothing entered by schools between the two collections. The preface says the SIGE platform is running but unfinished, its limits forcing GEPE onto Excel for the 2021/2022 yearbook.
